To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The knowledge bases of different types of industries, as well as the institutional frameworks of national innovation systems, strongly shape the innovation support provided by regional innovation systems.
1) there is a clear and strong correspondence between the knowledge base of a region and the character of its regional system of innovation.
the regional innovation system is a key concept to explain the innovation processes of a region and that the regional innovation systems are embedded in national innovation systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how the institutional context of a region affects the nature and effectiveness of its regional innovation system.
the relationship between the knowledge base of firms, the institutional context in which firms operate and the character of the regional innovation system.
the question of whether the national institutional framework and the regional innovation systems are complementary or contradictory.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
regional innovation systems are not only dependent on the knowledge bases of their industries, but also on the national institutional framework.
the character of a regional innovation system is shaped not only by the nature of the regional knowledge base, but also by the national and regional institutional framework, in which it is embedded.

regional innovation systems are shaped by both the knowledge bases of their industries and by the institutional frameworks of their respective national business systems, and that these factors interact to determine the character of the regional innovation systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a need for a contextualised analysis of the knowledge base and the institutional framework of regional innovation systems.
the knowledge bases and the institutional frameworks are the most important factors for the development of regional innovation systems.
the national business system and the national innovation system are important determinants for the type of regional innovation system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the regional innovation systems of different regions are shaped by the national business and innovation systems of which they are a part, and that this is a key factor in explaining the different forms and functions of regional innovation systems in different countries.

there is no single ‘best’ regional innovation system model, but rather that different regional innovation system types are better suited to different types of industry and national institutional frameworks.
regional innovation systems are shaped by their institutional context.
